key_point: Zelda started with a boy and a cave
title: Zelda started with a boy and a cave
caption: The Legend of Zelda came from Miyamoto's childhood adventures. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #zelda #nintendo

instagram.caption:
The Legend of Zelda grew out of Shigeru Miyamoto's childhood in the countryside near Kyoto.

He explored forests, lakes and fields with no map, and once found a hole in the ground. He came back with a lantern to explore the cave.

He wanted players to feel that thrill of discovering something alone. Every secret cave in Hyrule carries that memory.
